quotes.title: HD 106315
quotes.card: HD 106315, or K2-109, is a single star with a pair of close-orbiting exoplanets, located in the constellation of Virgo.
quotes.introduction: Based on parallax measurements, this system lies at a distance of 356 light years from the Sun.
